title: The Wild Oasis - Hotel Management Dashboard
description: Internal hotel management system for staff to manage bookings, cabins, guests, and hotel operations with comprehensive analytics and reporting.
longDescription: Comprehensive internal management system designed for hotel staff to efficiently manage all aspects of hotel operations. Features include booking management with check-in/check-out capabilities, cabin inventory management, guest data handling, and real-time analytics dashboard. The system provides staff with tools to monitor hotel performance, manage reservations, and maintain operational efficiency through intuitive interfaces and data visualization.
